scope: OFFLINE SIMULATION on the fake API server in offline_api.py. Times are simulated seconds under assumed latencies; they are not Kubernetes measurements. Separate from results-live.json.

model_assumptions.faults_per_schedule: 3-10 in t=[10,60] s, +12% chance of CR deletion at end

definitions.converged: from the end of the last fault, the API objects reach and STAY in the healthy state until the end of the run: owned Deployment+Service match spec, fake Deployment controller reports it available, image == spec.image (or, if spec.image is broken, a non-broken image), and for v2 variants status.observedGeneration == generation with the right Ready/Degraded condition. If the schedule deletes the CR: CR and all owned objects gone.
definitions.convergence_s: simulated seconds from the end of the last fault window to stable convergence
definitions.convergence_reconciles: reconcile calls (all replicas) in that interval
definitions.unhealthy_s: total simulated seconds from t=10 s to the end of the run during which the healthy check failed (captures outages DURING fault windows, e.g. while a crashed v1 is down)
definitions.unhealthy_objects_only_s: same, but never checks the CR status (v1/naive/none write no status, so this is the like-for-like comparison across variants)
definitions.invariants_ok: no successful controller write to an object not controlled by this CR; no write by a non-Lease-holder (v2); <=1 owned object per kind at every instant; hand-made look-alike Deployment untouched; <= 50 controller requests in every 1 s bucket; zero controller writes in the last 30 s once converged

variants.none: children applied once at t=0 (kubectl apply), no controller
variants.naive: 2 replicas, no leader election, no ownership check, blind patches, 10 ms retry, 0.5 s polling
variants.v1: exact v1 reconcile (v1/controller_v1.py) polled every 0.5 s by one replica - the code measured on k3s
variants.v2: 2 replicas with Lease election, informer cache + watches, rate-limited queue, finalizer, status, rollback
variants.v2_no_lease: ablation: v2 with both replicas active (relies only on resourceVersion conflicts)
variants.v2_no_refresh: ablation: v2 without the targeted cache re-read after a 409 (the first version I wrote)
